title: BARROW
description: In the flat bottom of a small valley, an approx. circular earthen mound with rounded profile has been cast up from the quarry ditch. The barrow has recently been ploughed and its profile is badly disturbed. The barrow measures 17m N/S x 16m W/E. The ditch is 3.2m wide x 0.4m below the external ground surface. The ploughed out remains of a second barrow lie 68m due S. See SM7 file for details of recent disturbance.

title: BARROW
description: Located on a platform on a gentle W-facing slope, this is the low remains of a barrow. Overall it measures 11m E-W & the enclosing ditch is 3m wide. It stands a max. of 0.4m high. The platform on which the barrow sits appears to have a slight lip, approx. 0.5m above the base of the ditch.
